//: Content for ui/pet/core/15-game-modes.js: each key is a CONTENT("key") there. tools/build_petcore.py puts it into petcore.js;
"//" keys are notes and are left out. Times are in milliseconds (a minute 60000, an hour 3600000, a day 86400000).

adventure.name: Adventure
adventure.about: Fall and you drop only your coins; your pets never die.

hardcore.name: Hardcore
hardcore.about: Fall and you lose everything you carry; pets can die in the far areas.

hell.name: Hell
hell.about: Fall and you die -- the game is over; pets can die too, and only a Necromancer can bring one back. Start again from nothing.
